defaults.authentication: Use the SPFx host's current-user SPHttpClient or MSGraphClientV3. Never request or persist access tokens in this library.
defaults.cache: IndexedDB scoped by tenant and signed-in user, with per-client memory failover; cache is best-effort and never an authorization boundary.

exampleCatalog.verification: Shipped TypeScript example sources are type-checked in the package build. They require a signed-in SPFx host at runtime; builds and unit tests do not verify tenant permissions or endpoint availability.

capabilities.name: site.resolve
capabilities.permission: Sites.Read.All delegated or narrower supported access

capabilities.name: list.discover
capabilities.permission: Sites.Read.All delegated or narrower supported access

capabilities.name: list.inspect
capabilities.permission: Sites.Read.All delegated or narrower supported access

capabilities.name: list.content-types
capabilities.limitations: Read-only helper. Graph does not expose SharePoint list view definitions; use authenticated SharePoint REST for views.

capabilities.name: list.items.page
capabilities.limitations: Server filtering supports eq, ne, lt, le, gt, ge, and startswith; indexed fields are recommended. Cursors remain bound to the same list and filter.

capabilities.name: react.list-items.filtered
capabilities.transport: React hook over cached Graph pages

capabilities.name: react.item-form.validation
capabilities.limitations: Native required controls use browser validation; required choice and reference fields receive an announced error, field validation state, and focus.

capabilities.name: react.item-form.references
capabilities.transport: Fluent UI React v9 ItemForm over authenticated Graph/SharePoint REST data
capabilities.limitations: The host loads bounded options and must inspect the target list. Graph <FieldName>LookupId mapping is documented; validate writes in the target tenant.

capabilities.name: copilot.ux.list-browser
capabilities.transport: SPFx 1.24 Copilot UX component with createSPFxServices
capabilities.permission: Sites.Read.All delegated; tenant admin approval required
capabilities.limitations: Requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on license. Read-only example; exact site/list arguments are required and validated.

capabilities.name: graph.batch
capabilities.limitations: Inspect individual response statuses; batched 429 responses must be retried individually using their Retry-After values.

capabilities.name: graph.calendar.view
capabilities.limitations: Uncached read of the signed-in user's default or selected calendar. Date bounds must include a timezone. Writes, shared calendars, and calendar groups remain raw Graph calls.

capabilities.name: graph.raw
capabilities.limitations: HTTPS graph.microsoft.com URLs only. Use responseType blob and rawBody for content. Large upload-session URLs are not accepted by the Graph host allowlist.

capabilities.name: client.retry-policy
capabilities.limitations: Retries 429/503 reads; writes are not retried unless explicitly marked retryable.

capabilities.name: client.storage
capabilities.limitations: Persistent storage can be requested; memory failover lasts for the createClient instance only.

capabilities.name: ui.custom-element
capabilities.limitations: The host must pass the existing authenticated SPFx client as a property; assigning it after connection triggers a refresh. Standalone HTML/Markdown has no implicit SPFx context.

capabilities.name: list.sync.delta
capabilities.limitations: Latest item state, not an audit log; expired cursors trigger a full list re-enumeration.

capabilities.name: item.create
capabilities.permission: Sites.ReadWrite.All delegated or narrower supported access
capabilities.confirmation: Agent host should review proposed field values with the user when ambiguous.

capabilities.name: item.update
capabilities.transport: Graph v1.0 with If-Match when cached ETag exists
capabilities.permission: Sites.ReadWrite.All delegated or narrower supported access
capabilities.confirmation: Requires user confirmation in agent tools.

capabilities.name: item.delete
capabilities.permission: Sites.ReadWrite.All delegated or narrower supported access

capabilities.name: sharepoint.rest.raw
capabilities.limitations: Same-origin HTTPS only; use for operations without typed wrappers.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.renderListDataAsStream
capabilities.limitations: Legacy response shapes remain adapter-specific.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.getListItemChangesSinceToken
capabilities.limitations: Returns legacy XML; Graph delta is preferred for new sync implementations.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.audienceTargeting
capabilities.limitations: The typed REST surface is not guaranteed across tenants; validate in the target tenant. PnP Core SDK/CSOM remains the known fallback.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.caml
capabilities.limitations: Call GetItems or RenderListDataAsStream through the raw REST adapter with CAML payloads.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.csom
capabilities.limitations: The .NET CSOM runtime is not included in SPFx; use a supported REST/Graph equivalent or a separately hosted service.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.drive-items
capabilities.permission: Delegated work/school read: Files.Read; drive mutations: Files.ReadWrite
capabilities.limitations: Drive delta represents latest item state, not every edit. Bounded calls persist a continuation checkpoint and return complete=false until the initial/change enumeration finishes. Move cannot cross drives. Copy is asynchronous and drops source metadata and permissions; the destination inherits its folder permissions. Delete moves items to the recycle bin. Deleted folders are removed only after child changes have been processed. Graph permissions are never cached. Version metadata is read directly without response caching. Graph exposes only permissions visible to the signed-in caller; this is not a complete ACL audit. Permission reads require endpoint-supported delegated access. Upload sessions use an HTTPS preauthenticated upload URL returned by Graph, without an Authorization header; browser CORS and host policy need target validation.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.versions
capabilities.transport: Microsoft Graph v1.0 listItem and driveItem versions
capabilities.permission: List-item versions: Sites.Read.All delegated; drive-item version reads: Files.Read; drive-item restore: Files.ReadWrite
capabilities.limitations: Returns retained version metadata and, for list items, version field values. Downloads previous file bytes without caching. Restore creates a new current version and requires user confirmation. Retention is service-controlled. SharePoint REST version operations remain raw.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.files-folders
capabilities.limitations: Use rawBody for binary upload and raw response blob() for download.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.attachments
capabilities.limitations: Applies to classic list item attachments, not document-library files. UI needs a numeric SharePoint item ID and uses two actions to confirm deletion; SharePoint permissions remain authoritative.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.markdown-files
capabilities.limitations: Raw HTML stays inert. Native SharePoint Markdown files do not execute SPFx or MDX; interactive rendering belongs in a compiled host app.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.role-assignments
typed: paged and auto-paged list role bindings
confirmed break/reset list inheritance; child scopes preserved on break
capabilities.entrypoint: sharepoint.getRoleDefinitionsPage, getListRoleAssignmentsPage, getListRoleAssignments, getListPermissionScope, breakListRoleInheritance, resetListRoleInheritance, addListRoleAssignment, removeListRoleAssignment
operations: web/site/item role assignment management beyond list scope
capabilities.limitations: Read responses and typed writes describe one list scope only. They do not resolve inherited parent assignments, Entra group membership, sharing links, or item-level unique scopes and are not an effective-access audit. SharePoint authorization governs access; every write requires explicit user confirmation.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.taxonomy
capabilities.limitations: Reads are paged and cached by the standard Graph response cache. Results are limited to taxonomy the signed-in user can access. Mutations and SharePoint taxonomy REST remain raw.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.views-content-types
capabilities.limitations: Graph list/column/content-type reads and SharePoint REST list-view reads are typed; content type mutations and view CRUD remain raw REST.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.search
capabilities.transport: Authenticated SharePoint Search REST via SPHttpClient
capabilities.permission: Signed-in user's SharePoint search access; no Graph scope
capabilities.limitations: The typed helper builds GET requests and returns SharePoint's native response. Complex POST queries and Microsoft Graph Search use raw transports; search results do not participate in list delta sync.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.users-profiles-groups
capabilities.limitations: Hosting-web site users and SharePoint groups only. Does not enumerate Entra ID, resolve effective access, or expand nested groups.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.user-profiles
capabilities.limitations: Read-only profile data remains subject to SharePoint profile availability and visibility. Account names are SharePoint claims logins, not Entra object IDs; profile values are not cached. Profile administration and social PeopleManager operations are not included.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.recycle-bin
capabilities.limitations: Recycle-bin reads are bounded and support web/site scope; permanent deletion requires explicit confirmation.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.regional-settings
capabilities.limitations: Read-only settings for the hosting web; values are not cached. Site usage remains raw-only.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.navigation
typed: bounded Quick Launch and top-navigation reads
capabilities.limitations: Navigation writes and deeper expansion remain raw REST. Pages are capped at 100 and continuation links are pinned to the same endpoint.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.user-custom-actions
capabilities.limitations: Web and site collection scopes use different routes.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.publishing
capabilities.limitations: Feature availability depends on site and tenant configuration.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.social
capabilities.limitations: Tenant and workload availability vary.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.workflows
capabilities.limitations: SharePoint 2013 workflows are retired in SharePoint Online as of April 2, 2026; on-premises Workflow Manager is a separate deployment.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.server-object-model
capabilities.limitations: Requires a supported server-side component; this package does not include a backend.

capabilities.name: sharepoint.notifications
capabilities.limitations: Graph notifications and SharePoint webhooks require a receiving endpoint; they are not browser push APIs.
